source: Written 2026-10-15 from the verified oracle text (Scryfall, fetched 2026-10-15) with its printed power/toughness, Scryfall's rulings (Bifur, Melodic Rider; Fíli the Pathfinder; Draconic Visitor; Parapet Thrasher; Hofri Ghostforge; Bloodforged Battle-Axe; The Eagles Are Coming!) and this deck's notes. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named. Rules retrieved with rules.py and cited: CR 603.10a (Hofri's dies trigger looks back in time, so it sees creatures dying with him), CR 903.9a (the owner MAY put a commander into the command zone, so Thorin can stay in the graveyard for Hofri), CR 603.3b (you put your own simultaneous triggers on the stack in any order), CR 603.2d (Bifur: an ability that triggers additional times triggers that many times), CR 202.1b and 202.3a (a token has no mana cost, so its mana value is 0 and Tocasia's Welcome sees it), CR 614.1a (Draconic Visitor's 'instead' is a replacement effect; its ruling: the Dragons have none of the replaced tokens' abilities). Bifur's rulings: an enduring story needs a storied permanent on the battlefield, and lasts the rest of the game once you have it. Power math: Thorin's +1/+0 counts artifact tokens only (Treasures, Axes, Battle-Axe copies), skips Thorin himself, and a sacrificed Treasure stops counting; Fíli's +1/+1 applies to all your creatures once you have an enduring story. No infinite combo is claimed.

scenes.head: Thorin, King of Durin's Folk
scenes.sub: Boros Dwarves. Every Dwarf that enters makes a Treasure, and every artifact token you control is +1/+0 on each of your other Dwarves.
scenes.say: Thorin, King of Durin's Folk. Boros Dwarves. Every Dwarf that enters makes a Treasure, and every artifact token you control is plus one plus zero on each of your other Dwarves.

scenes.head: Line one: a Treasure per Dwarf
scenes.sub: Whenever Thorin or another Dwarf you control enters, create a Treasure token. His own arrival counts, and so do Dwarf tokens.
scenes.say: Line one: a Treasure per Dwarf. Whenever Thorin or another Dwarf you control enters, create a Treasure token. His own arrival counts, and so do Dwarf tokens.

scenes.head: Line two: artifact tokens are power
scenes.sub: Other Dwarves you control get +1/+0 for each artifact token you control: Treasures, Axe tokens, Battle-Axe copies. Thorin never pumps himself.
scenes.say: Line two: artifact tokens are power. Other Dwarves you control get plus one plus zero for each artifact token you control. Treasures, Axe tokens and Battle-Axe copies all count. Thorin never pumps himself.

scenes.head: Turn 5: Thorin joins [[Giott, King of the Dwarves|Giott]] and [[Nori, Teller of Tales|Nori]]
scenes.sub: Five lands pay {3}{R}{W}. His own trigger makes a Treasure: one artifact token. Giott is now a 2/1 double striker, Nori a 3/2.
scenes.say: Turn five: Thorin joins Giott and Nori. Five lands pay for him, and his own trigger makes a Treasure: one artifact token. Giott is now a two-one double striker, and Nori a three-two.

scenes.head: Turn 6: [[Dori, Bearer of Friends|Dori]] for three
scenes.sub: Thorin's trigger and Dori's own each make a Treasure. Three artifact tokens now: every other Dwarf gets +3/+0.
scenes.say: Turn six: Dori, for three mana. Thorin's trigger and Dori's own each make a Treasure. That's three artifact tokens, so every other Dwarf gets plus three plus zero.

scenes.head: Attack: 17 damage, unblocked
scenes.sub: Giott is a 4/1 double striker: 8. Nori is a 5/2, Thorin a 4/4. Dori, a 6/2 trampler, waits a turn. Keep the Treasures: a spent one stops counting.
scenes.say: Attack, for seventeen damage unblocked. Giott is a four-one double striker, so that's eight. Nori is a five-two, and Thorin a four-four. Dori, a six-two trampler, waits a turn. Keep the Treasures: a spent one stops counting.

scenes.head: Then the company grows
scenes.sub: Four clips follow: Dwarves that bring Dwarves, [[Bifur, Melodic Rider|Bifur]] doubling every trigger, the dragon B-list, and how it wins.
scenes.say: Then the company grows. Four clips follow: Dwarves that bring Dwarves, Bifur doubling every Dwarf trigger, the dragon B-list, and how it wins.

scenes.head: [[Fíli the Pathfinder]]: Dwarves that bring Dwarves
scenes.sub: Whenever Fíli or another nontoken Dwarf you control enters, create a 2/2 red Dwarf token. That token is a Dwarf: another Thorin trigger.
scenes.say: Fíli the Pathfinder: Dwarves that bring Dwarves. Whenever Fíli or another nontoken Dwarf you control enters, create a two-two red Dwarf creature token. That token is a Dwarf too, so Thorin triggers again.

scenes.head: Turn 7: [[Fíli the Pathfinder|Fíli]], no tokens yet
scenes.sub: Thorin triggers for Fíli: a Treasure. Fíli triggers for itself: a 2/2 Dwarf token. The token is another Dwarf: a second Treasure.
scenes.say: Turn seven: Fíli, with last turn's Treasures spent. Thorin triggers for Fíli: a Treasure. Fíli triggers for itself: a two-two Dwarf token. The token is another Dwarf entering, so Thorin makes a second Treasure.

scenes.head: Count it: Fíli and the token are 5/3s
scenes.sub: Two artifact tokens: +2/+0. Thorin, Fíli and a Treasure make three legendaries and artifacts, an enduring story: Fíli gives your creatures +1/+1. Thorin is a 5/5.
scenes.say: Count it: Fíli and the token are five-threes. Two artifact tokens give plus two plus zero. Thorin, Fíli and a Treasure are three legendaries and artifacts: an enduring story, so Fíli gives your creatures plus one plus one. Thorin is a five-five.

scenes.head: Changelings are Dwarves
scenes.sub: [[Feisty Spikeling]] and [[Flock Impostor]] are every creature type, so each is a nontoken Dwarf: a Treasure from Thorin, and a 2/2 from Fíli that makes another.
scenes.say: Changelings are Dwarves. Feisty Spikeling and Flock Impostor are every creature type, so each one is a nontoken Dwarf. Thorin makes a Treasure, and Fíli makes a two-two, which makes another Treasure.

scenes.head: Flash in [[Flock Impostor|Impostor]], return [[Dori, Bearer of Friends|Dori]]
scenes.sub: On an opponent's end step: two Treasures and a 2/2. Recast Dori on your turn: three more Treasures and another 2/2.
scenes.say: Flash in Flock Impostor and return Dori to your hand. On an opponent's end step, that's two Treasures and a two-two. Recast Dori on your turn: three more Treasures, and another two-two.

scenes.head: [[An Unexpected Party // At the Door|At the Door]]: X Dwarves at once
scenes.sub: {X}{2}{W}: X 2/2 Dwarf tokens, so X Treasures; Fíli skips tokens. Later cast [[An Unexpected Party // At the Door|An Unexpected Party]] from exile, choosing Dwarf: +2/+2.
scenes.say: At the Door: X Dwarves at once. For X plus three mana, create X two-two Dwarf tokens, so Thorin makes X Treasures. Fíli skips tokens. Later, cast An Unexpected Party from exile and choose Dwarf: your Dwarves get plus two plus two.

cards.name: An Unexpected Party // At the Door

scenes.head: Card flow off every entry
scenes.sub: [[Kíli the Resourceful|Kíli]]: another Dwarf or Equipment enters, draw once a turn. [[Giott, King of the Dwarves|Giott]]: discard to draw on each. [[Tocasia's Welcome]]: small creatures entering draw once a turn, tokens included.
scenes.say: Card flow off every entry. Kíli draws when another Dwarf or Equipment enters, once a turn. Giott lets you discard a card to draw one, on each. Tocasia's Welcome draws when creatures with mana value three or less enter, once a turn. Tokens count: their mana value is zero.

scenes.head: [[Bifur, Melodic Rider]]: every Dwarf trigger, twice
scenes.sub: With an enduring story, if a triggered ability of a Dwarf you control triggers, it triggers an additional time. Thorin is a Dwarf: two Treasures per Dwarf.
scenes.say: Bifur, Melodic Rider: every Dwarf trigger, twice. With an enduring story, if a triggered ability of a Dwarf you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time. Thorin is a Dwarf, so every Dwarf makes two Treasures.

scenes.head: First, an enduring story
scenes.sub: Control three artifacts, legendaries and/or Sagas, with a storied permanent like Bifur. Bifur, Thorin and one Treasure do it, and the story lasts all game.
scenes.say: First, get an enduring story. You need three artifacts, legendaries or Sagas, and a permanent with storied, like Bifur. Bifur, Thorin and one Treasure do it, and once you have the story, it lasts the rest of the game.

scenes.head: Turn 8: [[Fíli the Pathfinder|Fíli]] with Bifur out
scenes.sub: Your Treasures are spent. Thorin triggers twice for Fíli: two Treasures. Fíli's own trigger fires twice: two 2/2 Dwarf tokens.
scenes.say: Turn eight: Fíli, with Bifur out and your old Treasures spent. Thorin triggers twice for Fíli: two Treasures. Fíli's own trigger fires twice: two two-two Dwarf tokens.

scenes.head: Each token: two more Treasures
scenes.sub: Each 2/2 is another Dwarf entering, and Thorin triggers twice for each: four more. Six Treasures and two 2/2s from one four-mana card.
scenes.say: Each two-two is another Dwarf entering, and Thorin triggers twice for each: four more Treasures. That's six Treasures and two two-twos from one four-mana card.

scenes.head: Six tokens: Fíli and the 2/2s are 9/3s
scenes.sub: +6/+0 from six artifact tokens, +1/+1 from Fíli's story. Bifur is an 11/6. Thorin never pumps himself: a 5/5.
scenes.say: Six artifact tokens: Fíli and both tokens are nine-threes. That's plus six plus zero from the tokens, and plus one plus one from Fíli's enduring story. Bifur is an eleven-six. Thorin never pumps himself, so he's a five-five.

scenes.head: Axes are artifact tokens too
scenes.sub: [[Iron Hills Blacksmith]] and [[Dáin Ironfoot]] each make an Axe, an Equipment artifact token. With Bifur, each makes two Axes and Thorin two Treasures: +4/+0.
scenes.say: Axes are artifact tokens too. Iron Hills Blacksmith and Dáin Ironfoot each make an Axe, an Equipment artifact token. With Bifur, each one makes two Axes, and Thorin makes two Treasures: four tokens, plus four plus zero on every other Dwarf.

scenes.head: [[Bloodforged Battle-Axe]] copies itself
scenes.sub: When the equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, create a token copy. Each copy is another artifact token, and once equipped, it copies itself too.
scenes.say: Bloodforged Battle-Axe copies itself. When the equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, create a token copy. Each copy is another artifact token, and once equipped, it copies itself too. It's the Axe's trigger, not a Dwarf's, so Bifur doesn't double it.

scenes.head: [[Draconic Visitor]]: Treasures become Dragons
scenes.sub: If one or more artifact tokens would be created under your control, that many 5/5 red Dragon creature tokens with flying are created instead. It isn't optional.
scenes.say: Draconic Visitor: Treasures become Dragons. If one or more artifact tokens would be created under your control, that many five-five red Dragon creature tokens with flying are created instead. It isn't optional.

scenes.head: Visitor out, then [[Dori, Bearer of Friends|Dori]]
scenes.sub: Thorin's Treasure and Dori's own are both replaced: two 5/5 flying Dragons. With [[Bifur, Melodic Rider|Bifur]]'s story, both trigger twice: four Dragons.
scenes.say: Visitor is out, then Dori enters. Thorin's Treasure and Dori's own Treasure are both replaced: two five-five flying Dragons. With Bifur and an enduring story, both abilities trigger twice: four Dragons.

scenes.head: The switch: no more Treasures
scenes.sub: Axes, Battle-Axe copies and [[Smaug the Magnificent|Smaug]]'s Treasure become Dragons too, with none of their abilities. Thorin's +1/+0 stops growing. Dragons aren't Dwarves: no loop.
scenes.say: The switch: no more Treasures. Axes, Battle-Axe copies and Smaug's upkeep Treasure become Dragons too, with none of their abilities. Thorin's bonus stops growing, and Dragons aren't Dwarves, so there's no loop. Cast Visitor to win, not to ramp.

scenes.head: [[Smaug the Magnificent]]
scenes.sub: Flying and haste. Each upkeep, a Treasure. Whenever he attacks, he deals damage equal to the number of Treasures you control to any target.
scenes.say: Smaug the Magnificent. Flying and haste. At the beginning of your upkeep, a Treasure. Whenever he attacks, he deals damage equal to the number of Treasures you control to any target. Before Visitor, he's the Treasure plan's finisher.

scenes.head: [[Parapet Thrasher]]: Dragons that connect
scenes.sub: Your Dragons hit an opponent: choose a mode not yet chosen this turn. Destroy that player's artifact, deal 4 to each other opponent, or exile your top card to play this turn.
scenes.say: Parapet Thrasher. Whenever your Dragons deal combat damage to an opponent, choose a mode not yet chosen this turn: destroy that player's artifact, deal four to each other opponent, or exile your top card to play this turn. Visitor's tokens are Dragons.

scenes.head: [[Hellkite Tyrant]]: twenty artifacts wins
scenes.sub: Flying, trample. A combat hit takes all of that player's artifacts. At your upkeep with twenty or more artifacts, you win. Treasures count; Visitor's Dragons don't.
scenes.say: Hellkite Tyrant. Flying and trample. When it deals combat damage to a player, you gain control of all their artifacts. At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control twenty or more artifacts, you win the game. Treasures count. Visitor's Dragons don't.

scenes.head: [[The Misty Mountains Cold]]
scenes.sub: A Saga: each chapter makes a Treasure, and at four Treasures you sacrifice it for a 6/6 flying Dragon. Under Visitor, each chapter's Treasure is a 5/5 Dragon instead.
scenes.say: The Misty Mountains Cold. A Saga: each chapter makes a Treasure, and once you control four Treasures, you sacrifice it for a six-six flying Dragon. With Visitor out, each chapter's Treasure is a five-five Dragon instead.

clips.title: How it wins and protects itself

scenes.head: Turn 9: [[Secret Tunnel]] makes two Dwarves unblockable
scenes.sub: {4}, {T}: two creatures you control that share a creature type can't be blocked. Six Treasures and the story make [[Fíli the Pathfinder|Fíli]] and a 2/2 token 9/3s: 18 damage.
scenes.say: Turn nine, after the Bifur turn. Secret Tunnel makes two of your creatures that share a creature type unblockable. Six Treasures and the story make Fíli and a two-two token nine-threes: eighteen damage. Pay the four with lands: a sacrificed Treasure stops counting.

scenes.head: Protect the company
scenes.sub: [[Bofur, Reliable Guardian // Concerted Care|Concerted Care]]: hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. [[Bilbo's Gambit]]: return a spell to its owner's hand; promise the gift and no one casts spells this turn.
scenes.say: Protect the company. Concerted Care gives an artifact or creature you control hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. Bilbo's Gambit returns a spell to its owner's hand. Promise the gift, an opponent gets a Treasure, and no one can cast spells this turn.

scenes.head: Wrath incoming: [[The Eagles Are Coming!]]
scenes.sub: Kicked, return any number of your creatures to hand in response. Next upkeep, a 4/4 flying Bird for each, tokens included. Recast the Dwarves for new Treasures.
scenes.say: Wrath incoming: The Eagles Are Coming. Kicked, it returns any number of your creatures to your hand in response. At the next upkeep, you create a four-four flying Bird for each one, tokens included. Then recast the Dwarves for new Treasures.

scenes.head: [[Blasphemous Act]] with [[Hofri Ghostforge|Hofri]] out
scenes.sub: 13 damage to each creature. Hofri's trigger looks back in time (CR 603.10a), so it sees creatures that die with him: your other nontoken creatures return as Spirit copies.
scenes.say: Blasphemous Act, with Hofri out. Thirteen damage to each creature. Hofri's trigger looks back in time, so it sees creatures dying alongside him: your other nontoken creatures come back as Spirit token copies. Treasures aren't creatures, so they survive.

scenes.head: Leave Thorin in the graveyard
scenes.sub: The command zone is optional (CR 903.9a), and you order your own triggers (CR 603.3b). Copy Thorin first: his copy and every Dwarf copy after it make a Treasure.
scenes.say: Leave Thorin in the graveyard. The command zone is the owner's choice, and you order your own triggers. From the command zone, Hofri can't exile him: no copy. Copy Thorin first: his copy and every Dwarf copy after it make a Treasure.

scenes.head: Better: [[Bofur, Reliable Guardian // Concerted Care|Concerted Care]] on Hofri first
scenes.sub: Indestructible, he survives the 13 damage, and his Spirits get +1/+1, trample and haste. Their creatures take 13 too; your copies attack this turn.
scenes.say: Better: cast Concerted Care on Hofri first. Indestructible, he survives the thirteen damage, and his Spirits get plus one plus one, trample and haste. Their creatures take thirteen too, and your copies attack this turn.

scenes.head: Thorin, King of Durin's Folk
scenes.sub: Bracket 2 · a Treasure per Dwarf, power per token · the full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: Thorin, King of Durin's Folk. Bracket two. A Treasure for every Dwarf, and power for every token. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
